test_title: PYST 66: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Having unlimited power
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct one-word substitute for the phrase "Having unlimited power" is **Omnipotent**.
 
• Omnipotent refers to the quality of having unlimited or infinite power, especially in reference to a deity or supreme being.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.

**Correct sentence:** *Having unlimited power is a quality often attributed to omnipotent beings.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** Omnipresence refers to the quality of being present everywhere, which does not fit the meaning of having unlimited power.
 
• **Option 3:** Omniscient means all-knowing, which is unrelated to having unlimited power.
 
• **Option 4:** Omnivorous refers to an organism that eats both plants and animals, which does not fit the context of unlimited power.
